correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the rank using the Gram span of the vertexwise products ψ_E,i overline(ψ_E,j) within common energy spaces, from the complex-Hermitian Cesàro projection. A nonzero Bloch block has energies ±|a+b exp(iθ)| and flat intensities, so simple levels all give the same all-ones direction. Since ab>0, distinct cell angles can share a positive magnitude only as negatives of each other, which requires 0 or π flux modulo 2π. For such a pair the product lies at cell shift frequency ±(j−k), with two-sublattice line of coordinate ratio equal to one of the squared phases of a+b exp(iθ). The signed energy blocks generate the same product lines. At odd m the congruence 2j=ℓ or 2j+1=ℓ has one solution for each ℓ≠0, giving one line per activated frequency. At even m it has either two or no solutions. The two angles differ by π; parallel lines would make the quotient of the two complex off-diagonal entries real, contrary to Im[(a+b exp(iθ))(a−b exp(−iθ))]=2ab sinθ. At the self-inverse nonzero frequency the two orientations of a single collision still give independent conjugate lines, since θ=±π/2 and a,b are both positive. The counts are m/2−1 nonzero even frequencies at zero flux and m/2 odd frequencies at π. Finally a=b and θ=π produces two independent sublattice intensities at frequency zero rather than just the uniform direction. It occurs exactly at the claimed parity and twist boundary. This accounts for all product vectors, including m=2 and a=b, and gives exactly the stated table without tolerance-based rank inference.
residual_risks: The recorded finite verifier uses numerical eigengap and rank tolerances; it is not a proof of exact degeneracy close to the exceptional sets.
The classification assumes positive hoppings and exact infinite-time Cesàro averaging; it does not imply a uniform finite-time approach near flux or gap closing.

value.rationale: Rank of the stationary Cesàro transition map measures the dimension of distinguishable initial-site information in time-averaged position readout. The exceptional ranks give a complete classification for a natural clean dimerized ring, and isolate exactly when a closing band gap adds a sublattice memory mode. That distinction is not available from generic flat-eigenvector mixing or the uniform cycle alone.
residual_risks: The invariant does not quantify finite-time observability near rank jumps or behavior under disorder and extra bonds.
